text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? A magic show assistant!?
Me!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I'd love for Pokke to take part
in the show we're putting on for the children's club next time."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your radiant cheerfulness is sure to brighten up the children's day!
That's why I'd love for you to join us.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yes! Pick me!!
I'll do it!! Please let me do it!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! In that case, I shall teach you
a very special magic trick.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The Ace of Hearts in my hand.
If I focus my mind on it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Haaah!
Alright! Just moved it into your pocket!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? As if that'd happen!
Hey, check real carefully!
Maybe it's in the other pocket, y'know?
choice_data_list: ...What's that on the floor over there?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaaaah~~!!
It blew right past me agaaain!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, this teleportation magic just won't work out!
One more time, let's go again!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Daaah, crap! Again?!
And we barely have any time before the main event...

Jungle Pocket kept failing after that.
It seemed like the kind of magic trick
that an amateur couldn't pull off right away to begin with—
choice_data_list: In that case, why not switch to a simple magic trick?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“......Huh?
Are you seriously saying that?”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna change it.
Listen here, Fuji-san told me—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little tough,
but I'm sure you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke is the "strongest" hard worker, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A simpler magic trick...
Fuji-san should know plenty of those.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Still, the fact that you went out of your way to tell me this means you're determined not to back down from the show, and—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "It's 'cause you believed I could do it. So I gotta show you, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The Jungle Pocket you believed in
will far surpass any expectations," she says.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll stick with you all the way!
Got it, I'll stick with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
One, two... Haaah!!
—How was that, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: ...Ah, there's a card in my pocket!
...Yeah, there's a card in the pocket!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhhh!!
Teleportation: HUGE successsss!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't be satisfied with just this.
I gotta make a flashy splash in the real race.
choice_data_list: Since we're at it, why don't we surprise Fuji Kiseki too?
Let's practice over and over to improve our success rate!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ? What are you gonna do to Fuji-san?
choice_data_list: Maybe use the magic tricks you learned to pull off a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what is this...!
This got me seriously fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Before I knew it, the playing cards were in my pocket!
Amazing! Sooo amazing!!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's give a big round of applause to Big Sis Pokke for that incredible magic trick~~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Too early to call it quits!
From here on out, it's a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take this coin like this...
......Aaaand hup!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder where that coin went~?
――Right, Fuji-san?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...!? Since when...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-daaa!!
The coin teleportation magic is a huge success!!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Not bad at all, Pokke!
That was amazing... the greatest surprise ever!
I haven't felt this thrilled in so long!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—...!!!!
Thaaanks a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's an absolute honor
to hear that from you, Fuji-san!!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Too early to call it quits!
From here on out, it's a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take this coin like this...
......Aaaand hup!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Fuji-san!
Where do you think the coin went?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. That much I can tell.
Your Trainer should definitely have it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my Trainer was... wait, what?

According to Jungle Pocket's plan,
the coin was supposed to be planted on Fuji Kiseki.
However, thrusting a hand into the pocket...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that she noticed my surprise
and counter-surprised me...?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!!!!
Fuji-san is just so freakin' cooool...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Too early to call it quits!
From here on out, it's a surprise...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, huh? Hey!!
Did I drop my magic trick coin!?)

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, heeey. What's the surprise~?
—What kind of magic trick are you gonna show us next~?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, little ponies! Eyes on me!
One, two...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Here!
A surprise bouquet for you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (...! Far from surprising Fuji-san, I ended up having her cover for me...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Tch...! I gotta get my head in the game so I don't cause any more trouble.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Stick with me for a bit more practice, partner.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Before I knew it, the playing cards were in my pocket!
Amazing! Sooo amazing!!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks.
Seeing you smile like that makes me happy too.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—...! Hey, hey, Big Sis Pokke!
What else are you gonna show us?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad.
That's the only magic trick I know.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh~~!?
—Then do it again! Do it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. The little ponies seem to be
utterly captivated by you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aw, fine~. Fuji-san's magic is waiting too,
so just one more time, got it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Geez, those guys.
Demanding encore after encore.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke. Thank you so much for participating today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a huge hit thanks to you.
Asking you to be my partner was definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san... Thanks a ton!!
It's an honor to hear that from you!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: One, two... Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah! The playing cards ended up in my pocket without me noticing!
Amazing, so amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's give a big round of applause to Big Sis Pokke for that incredible magic trick~~!
And so, Jungle Pocket pulled off her magic trick with great success.
